shots.description: Title screen over the living city: VICE BAY, story intro, controls, and the saved-game line.
Driving through Vice Bay: the player car on the avenue, traffic, HUD with cash, health, mission objective, and the minimap.
Three-star police chase: VCPD cars with flashing light bars behind the player, wanted stars, siren, mission objective on the HUD.
Win screen after all three jobs: VICE BAY MILIKMU with final cash and run stats.

tool: Playwright (chromium headless) driving the game served from game/ on localhost
